summary: electro-optical/infrared sensors of the Enhanced Integrated Sensor Suite (RQ-4 Block 20/30)

wavelength_min_um.note: Atmospheric MWIR passband lower edge (3.0 um)

wavelength_max_um.note: Atmospheric LWIR passband upper edge (12.0 um)

nei_w_m2.note: Unpublished Noise-Equivalent Irradiance; RQ-4B EISS high-altitude long-range EO/IR reconnaissance sensor class estimate (Hudson IR System Engineering bounds)

detection_snr.note: Linear detection SNR threshold (~7.8 dB) for low false-alarm point-target IR/UV detection

lookdown_factor.note: Background-clutter NEI multiplier when looking below horizon against warm Earth/cloud background

azimuth_limit_deg.note: Assumed azimuth field-of-regard half-angle for RQ-4B EISS high-altitude long-range EO/IR reconnaissance sensor

elevation_min_deg.note: Assumed lower elevation field-of-regard limit for RQ-4B EISS high-altitude long-range EO/IR reconnaissance sensor

elevation_max_deg.note: Assumed upper elevation field-of-regard limit for RQ-4B EISS high-altitude long-range EO/IR reconnaissance sensor

angle_sigma_mrad.note: Unpublished angular measurement 1-sigma at threshold for RQ-4B EISS high-altitude long-range EO/IR reconnaissance sensor

angle_floor_mrad.note: Unpublished high-SNR stabilized angular error floor for RQ-4B EISS high-altitude long-range EO/IR reconnaissance sensor

measure_s.note: Nominal optical frame/scan track update period

memory_s.note: Optical track coast memory during temporary cloud/aspect occultation

continuous.note: Requires explicit Search or Track tasking

laser_capable.note: Passive-only electro-optical sensor without laser rangefinder

hudson-ir.title: R. D. Hudson, Infrared System Engineering (Wiley, 1969) & atmospheric MWIR (3-5 um) / LWIR (8-12 um) / solar-blind UV (0.25-0.28 um) windows
